meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会先读取你 shadcn 项目的配置和已装组件,再按官方规则添加、查找、修复组件,而且动手前会先拉取该组件的文档与示例。
howto.when: 当你在处理 shadcn/ui 组件、注册表、preset 等场景,或项目里含 components.json 时自动接管;说「shadcn init」时也会触发。

say.text: 帮我加一个 dialog 组件
say.note: 先查项目和已装组件,再运行 add

say.text: 搜索注册表里有没有登录页的 block
say.note: 会先问你用哪个注册表,不替你猜

say.text: 帮我看看这个组件的用法和示例
say.note: 拉取该组件的文档与示例链接

howto.what_en: Claude reads your shadcn project config and installed components, then adds, searches, and fixes components by the official rules, fetching each component's docs and examples first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with shadcn/ui components, registries, preset codes, or a project containing components.json; also for "shadcn init" or creating an app with --preset.

say_en.text: Add a dialog component for me
say_en.note: Checks project and installed components, then runs add

say_en.text: Search registries for a login block
Show me the docs and examples for this component
say_en.note: Fetches the component's docs and example URLs
